subject: Transit boundary declaration & private deploy controls for EU-only deployment
messages:
From: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@veridian.health>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@veridian.health
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: regional transit boundaries + private deployment controls (EU)

Neha,

Thanks for the call earlier. As part of our procurement and security review for the EU pilot, the security team has two asks we'd like you to confirm in writing:

1) Transit and processing boundaries — we need a short declaration that production inference for Veridian will only process and persist request/response data in EU-hosted nodes (no backups or failover replication landing outside the EU). If there are any temporary cross-border traces (control plane, logging, metrics), please identify them and the retention window.

2) Private deployment controls — because we'll be using a Private deployment with VPC peering, we require a concise matrix of controls: peering topology, egress minimization, KMS/HSM key partitioning (can keys be customer-managed?), and whether KV cache or any disk-backed artifacts ever leave the peered subnet.

We'd also appreciate a CAIQ slice (highlighting the Sig/CAIQ answers relevant to networking and key management) and any runbook or diagram you can share. Our deadline for the security packet is 2027-08-05 COB.

Thanks,
Lisa Carter
Head of Security Programs
Veridian Health

Attachments: Veridian_SIG_request_20270801.xlsx

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@veridian.health>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: regional transit boundaries + private deployment controls (EU)

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. High level answers up front, full artifacts attached and linked below. Will follow up with a short technical call if you want us to walk through the artifacts.

- EU processing: For your production tenant we will run inference only on EU-located execution nodes (pinned AZs/regions). Model weights, transient KV cache, and persisted artifacts for that tenant are hosted in those EU zones.

- Control plane and telemetry: Our control plane (orchestration + scheduling) is multi-region for reliability, but control plane telemetry is scrubbed and retained at a summary level for 90 days by default. No raw Veridian inference payloads are retained outside EU zones. Any cross-border metrics are aggregated and contain no customer prompt/response content.

- VPC/private deploy topology: We support VPC peering and Private deployments with a customer-dedicated subnet. Peering is one-way (Redwood -> customer egress only where configured), NAT egress minimization is available via private endpoints, and we can disable public internet egress for your tenant.

- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed ciphertext keys via supported KMS providers in the EU region. Key usage is scoped per-tenant; we can enable HSM-backed key wraps. We offer an optional split-key approach for enterprise (Redwood-held wrap key + customer master key) — see attached brief.

- KV cache / disk artifacts: Runtime KV caches are in-memory on the execution nodes in the EU fleet. Under normal operation they are not written to disk; for incidents we may create encrypted disk snapshots for debugging but only within EU-hosted storage and only with customer consent unless otherwise required by law.

I've attached: redwood-eu-privatelink-architecture.pdf, kms-separation-brief.pdf, redwood-caiq-slice.xlsx, and a draft DPA addendum. Links to the Drive folder and our HubSpot ticket are below.

If helpful, Ben (ops) and Marissa (compliance) are on copy and can surface the CAIQ slice and supporting diagrams. We can also do a 30-minute call tomorrow afternoon to walk through specifics.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-eu-privatelink-architecture.pdf; kms-separation-brief.pdf; redwood-caiq-slice.xlsx; dpa_addendum_v2.pdf

Lisa — attaching the packet requested and linking the Drive folder for full artifacts. Short summary:

- Execution & storage: Production inference and tenant artifacts for Veridian will be hosted only on EU execution nodes and EU-block storage. No persistent customer payloads are replicated to non-EU regions.
- Control plane: Control-plane scheduling is multi-region; control-plane telemetry is aggregated and contains no raw customer content. Aggregated telemetry is retained 90 days by default; we can shorten retention for PCI/PHI workloads per contract.
- VPC peering topology & egress: Attached peering diagram shows a one-way peering arrangement with egress filtering and private endpoints. Public egress can be disabled.
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys supported. HSM-backed wrapping is available and we document split-key options in the brief.
